Element.Description: Translation offset from the first actor connected by Connect/Attach. With UseParentRotation enabled, the offset follows the parent's current orientation and optional LocatorName. Otherwise, its initial world-space direction is retained.

Euler rotation offset applied when attaching to the parent. With UseParentRotation enabled, it is combined with the parent's current transform and optional LocatorName. Otherwise, the initial attachment orientation is retained.
Parent model locator used as the attachment point. If the name cannot be resolved, the light follows the parent actor's transform instead.

Follows the parent's orientation as well as its position, using LocatorName when available. When disabled, only the attachment position follows the parent; the initial world-space offset and orientation are retained. A connected CameraTarget/Attach actor can override the light's orientation afterward.
